en: Sepia-toned photograph of a large, ornate neoclassical building with two stories plus a raised basement, tall rectangular windows, and arched windows on the ground floor. The facade has pilasters, decorative window pediments, and a central entrance with steps and a small portico. Along the roofline is a balustrade and an elaborate sculpted crest bearing Latin text, including the word 'INSTITUT.' In the foreground is a path or driveway bordered by a clipped hedge and lawn. At the bottom of the image, handwritten text identifies the location and date.
